name: mirage
text:
v1.0.100 is released with both fixes: Unlimited bids is honored (no more 400 cap), and The Odds API keys are used in your order, one after another, instead of spreading over all 23.
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.100
The engine itself picks the fix up on its next restart. I still can't add the PinnAPI key from here: paste it in Settings > APIs > PinnAPI, then Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys to GitHub.
